payload.title: Qualify payments, refunds and settled cash accounting
payload.goal: Accept eligible scoped payments and reconcile funds, fees, refunds and fulfillment separately.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: After a prospect accepts scope, reuse owner merchant route if eligible; collect only credential references, exact account/currency/capability and signed webhook/lookup contract.
Create invoice or checkout intent keyed to accepted order revision and idempotency key; verify receiving merchant account and provider transaction state.
Reconcile authorized/captured/settled/refunded/disputed states, fees and cash actually received; append adjustments instead of rewriting history.
Bind scoped refund eligibility, identity/policy and amount limit to provider action; preserve unknown response and reconcile before retry.
Enforce zero pre-revenue spending and one bundled reinvestment event capped at 50% available settled cash, preserving reserve and rejecting transaction splitting.
deliverables: sandbox results and eligible provider receipts
tests: Sandbox duplicate webhook, delayed settlement, partial/full refund, charge timeout and fee correction fixtures preserve exact cents and no duplicate charge/refund.
Wrong account, unsigned webhook, unaccepted scope and unknown budget deny effect.
Provider reconciliation readback matches ledger balances; settled funds differ from pending payout and invoice totals.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: Payment taking remains gated until actual merchant route and scope are verified.
Any revenue claim includes actual provider cash receipt, fees/refunds and linked fulfilled value; lack of transactions remains unvalidated.
payload.rollback: Disable checkout/invoice creation; retain reconciliation and fulfill existing obligations; never auto-refund merely because a deployment rolls back.
payload.next_eligible_action: Implement deterministic sandbox ledger and adapter contract; queue one merchant-readiness question only when an accepted scope makes it necessary.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Merchant onboarding is non-delegable where provider requires it; no new account/budget assumed.
